sources.title: Announcing Cohere's Command A Reasoning Model
sources.evidence: Dated August 21, 2025 announcement names command-a-reasoning-08-2025, 111 billion parameters, 256K context, 23 languages, reasoning controls and tool use.

sources.title: Model Card for Cohere Labs Command A Reasoning
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs, open weights, 111B size, CC-BY-NC with acceptable-use requirements, text-only input and text output, reasoning, conversational tools, and an autoregressive Transformer combining sliding-window/RoPE and global attention.

sources.title: CC-BY-NC 4.0 License with Acceptable Use Addendum
sources.evidence: The model card links this CC-BY-NC 4.0 license with the Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Addendum.

sources.title: Cohere's Command A Reasoning Model
sources.evidence: Exact dated model ID; 256,000-token context; 32,000-token maximum output; enterprise agents, RAG, tools and multilingual use.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+: Making sovereign agentic capabilities available to all
sources.evidence: May 20, 2026 comparison explicitly includes Command A Reasoning in the Command A family: size 111B, reasoning and tools supported, multimodal absent, 23 languages. The 218B total / 25B active figures belong to Command A+, not this model.

sources.title: Official checkpoint public repository metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Cohere Labs checkpoint
sources.evidence: Metadata for revision bd39aafe2c5e71a044d2f1674accfd9b384d3dbb identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM, model_type cohere2, Command A 03-2025 base, cc-by-nc-4.0, and a safetensors aggregate of 111,057,580,032 BF16 elements. Repository creation was August 12, 2025; this alone does not establish public release.

sources.title: Transformers Cohere2ForCausalLM implementation, v4.55.0
sources.evidence: Implementation matching the checkpoint architecture contains causal decoder attention and dense gated MLP projections in each decoder layer. Rotary frequencies are non-persistent buffers. This supports dense Transformer classification, without equating active and total parameters.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration (gated)
sources.evidence: Direct configuration access returned HTTP 401. Full checkpoint configuration and individual tensor headers were not inspected; no independently reconstructed exact learned-parameter count is claimed.

sources.title: Command A Reasoning documentation source
sources.evidence: Source lists the supported capability flags without Image Inputs; the rendered page extraction includes all capability labels. Confirms 256,000 context and the exact model ID. Its draft createdAt date is not a release announcement.

sources.title: Baseline Hugging Face URL
sources.evidence: Baseline URL returned HTTP 401; the accessible official checkpoint is CohereLabs/command-a-reasoning-08-2025.

sources.title: OCI Cohere Command A Reasoning
sources.evidence: Provider page claims image inputs and a four-layer architecture. These conflict with Cohere's explicit text-only card and its attention-pattern description; provider statements are not adopted for the Cohere checkpoint.

name.note: Official announcement name for the exact dated ID.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and its Cohere Labs research group.

family.note: Explicitly included in the Command A family; checkpoint metadata identifies the Command A base.

release_date.note: Public launch date. Earlier repository creation is not evidence of earlier public availability.

open_weights.note: Official open-weights research release; downloads require accepting access terms.

license.note: License linked by the exact card; noncommercial weights license includes acceptable-use conditions.

parameters_b.note: Published nominal whole-model count in billions. Hub reports 111,057,580,032 BF16 elements, but gated configuration/tensor access prevents independently validating that aggregate as an exact learned-parameter count.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active count in the reviewed model card or later comparison. Dense architecture does not justify copying the total.

architecture.note: Autoregressive dense decoder Transformer: exact metadata maps to Cohere2ForCausalLM and its dense MLP implementation. Attention alternates local windows and global layers; the four-layer pattern is not a four-layer total.

context_window.note: Explicit token count in exact-model documentation.

modalities.note: Card explicitly says text-only input and text output; later Cohere comparison agrees. Oracle image-input claim conflicts. Rendered generic capability labels are not positive support flags.

reasoning.note: Optional thinking and user-controlled thinking budget are explicitly documented.

tool_call.note: Official launch and checkpoint card document conversational tool use.

description.value: Cohere reasoning model for multilingual enterprise agents, tools, and complex workflows
description.note: Supported use-case summary, without unsupported comparative performance claims.

patch.notes: 111B is Cohere's nominal whole-model parameter count. A separate active-parameter count is not reported. The exact checkpoint is a dense autoregressive Transformer with interleaved sliding-window and global attention. Open weights use CC-BY-NC 4.0 with an Acceptable Use Addendum. The correct checkpoint repository omits the c4ai- prefix.

sources.label: Weights license with Acceptable Use Addendum

summary: Adds the nominal 111B total, dense Transformer architecture, and CC-BY-NC 4.0 license with Acceptable Use Addendum; replaces the main catalog citation with the explicit primary release announcement and supplies the correct weights URL. Confirms the other factual fields. Active count remains undisclosed. Records provider modality/architecture conflicts and gated configuration access; does not promote Hub storage metadata to an exact learned count.
